protocol: 1. Read this file. Statuses: TODO, RUNNING, RETRY, DONE, BLOCKED, BLOCKED-JOEY.
2. Ready = deps all DONE and status in {TODO, RETRY}. Pick <=3 with no overlapping owns; <=1 touching docker/act; <=1 making real claude -p calls.

3. H task -> Agent(model: haiku, subagent_type: general-purpose) with: task row verbatim, absolute paths, the relevant 'fixed' and 'layers' entries, and: 'Edit ONLY these paths. DO NOT modify anything else. Do not commit. Do not push. Red fixture before green. Report the done command and its raw output.' S task -> driver does it itself.

4. Driver re-runs the done check ITSELF after each task. A subagent report is never evidence. Pass -> DONE + write evidence/<task>/done.log (command, exit code, last 20 lines). Fail -> attempts++, last_error = short signature; 3rd failure with same signature -> BLOCKED + root-cause note (no 4th try).
5. Commit each DONE task immediately on the worktree branch through lefthook (no bypass), message 'specgate: <task> <summary>' with '## Acceptance:' line citing the done result.
6. Update tasks + loop fields here. Exit with <=5-line summary: tasks changed, blockers.
